This notebook draws all figures of the manuscript (Figures 4–9) and of the
Supplementary Material (Figure S1). Each figure has its own chunk and can be run
and edited on its own. The figures are built from the results of
`model_evaluation.R` (tables in `results/tables/`, model outputs in
`results/figure_data/`) and the prepared data (`Data/`), so no model has to be
re-fitted to change a figure.

Run the chunks in RStudio (working directory `R/`), or render the whole notebook
with `rmarkdown::render("figures.Rmd")`. With `save_png <- TRUE`, every chunk also
writes its figure to `results/figures/`.

# Setup

```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
library(sf); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(scico); library(patchwork); library(shapviz)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

data_dir <- Sys.getenv("BAM_DATA_DIR", file.path("..", "Data"))
res_dir  <- Sys.getenv("BAM_RESULTS_DIR", file.path("..", "results"))
tab_dir  <- file.path(res_dir, "tables")
fig_data <- file.path(res_dir, "figure_data")
fig_dir  <- file.path(res_dir, "figures")
save_png <- TRUE          # set to FALSE to only preview the figures

save_figure <- function(p, name, width, height, dpi = 300) {
  if (save_png) ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  p
}
```

## Styles

```{r styles}
source_note <- "Source: Open Data Zurich, 2026"
scenario_colours <- c("Baseline" = "black", "Optimal" = "green3", "Congested" = "red3",
                      "Realistic" = "purple", "Control 1" = "orange1", "Control 2" = "orange3")

# frame, title, caption and legend of the map panels
theme_panel <- function(legend = "right") theme_void(base_size = 12) + theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5, margin = ggplot2::margin(6, 0, 6, 0)),
  plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
  plot.caption.position = "plot",
  plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
  plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 10, 8, 10),
  legend.position = legend, legend.title = element_text(size = 10), legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
  legend.key.height = unit(0.9, "cm"), legend.key.width = unit(0.4, "cm"))

# background of all maps: city boundary, forest, lake and road network
base_layers <- function() list(
  geom_sf(data = context$city, fill = "white", colour = "#cccccc", linewidth = 0.3),
  geom_sf(data = context$forest, fill = alpha("green4", 0.2), colour = NA),
  geom_sf(data = context$lake, fill = alpha("deepskyblue", 0.3), colour = NA),
  geom_sf(data = road_network, colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.15))

finish_map <- function(p, title) p + coord_sf(crs = 2056, datum = NA) +
  labs(title = title, caption = source_note, x = NULL, y = NULL)

four_panels <- function(plots) wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2) &
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6))
```

## Data

```{r data}
ctx <- function(n) st_read(file.path(data_dir, "context", paste0(n, ".gpkg")), quiet = TRUE)
context <- list(city = ctx("city_boundary"), lake = ctx("lake"), forest = ctx("forest"))
road_network <- st_read(file.path(data_dir, "infrastructure", "road_network.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE) %>%
  filter(SpedLmt < 80, SpedLmt != 0)
accidents_xy <- as.data.frame(st_coordinates(st_read(file.path(data_dir, "accidents", "accidents.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE)))

# prediction grid (200,000 points, 25 m buffer, 5 m cells); same rows as the scenario predictions
grid <- st_read(file.path(data_dir, "prediction_grid", "grid_200000_points_25m_buffer_5m_cells.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE) %>%
  subset(SpedLmt < 80 & SpedLmt != 0)
grid_xy <- st_coordinates(grid)

# predicted probabilities of the reference GB model for all scenarios and grid points
scen <- readRDS(file.path(fig_data, "scenario_predictions.rds"))
sp <- scen$predictions; youden <- scen$youden
shown <- c("Baseline", "Optimal", "Congested", "Realistic")
P <- setNames(lapply(shown, function(s) sp$p[sp$scenario == s]), shown)
stopifnot(all(lengths(P) == nrow(grid_xy)))

# mean value per 25 m cell (Figures 6 and 7)
cells <- function(v, res = 25)
  setNames(aggregate(v ~ x + y, data.frame(x = floor(grid_xy[, 1] / res) * res + res / 2,
                                           y = floor(grid_xy[, 2] / res) * res + res / 2, v = v), mean),
           c("x", "y", "value"))
```

# Figure 4: Distribution of predicted probabilities

Density of the predicted probabilities per scenario; dashed line: threshold 0.8,
dotted line: Youden-optimal threshold.

```{r figure-4, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4}
p <- ggplot(sp, aes(p, colour = scenario)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = youden, linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = scenario_colours) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  labs(subtitle = "Gradient Boosting (GB)", x = "Predicted Accident Probability", y = "Density", colour = "Scenario") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, face = "italic"),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"))
save_figure(p, "figure_4_probability_density", width = 8, height = 4)
```

# Figure 5: Predicted accident locations

Grid points with a predicted probability ≥ 0.8 (black) over the kernel density of
the recorded accidents.

```{r figure-5, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 12.4}
map_hotspots <- function(scenario, threshold = 0.8) {
  pts <- data.frame(x = grid_xy[, 1], y = grid_xy[, 2])[P[[scenario]] >= threshold, ]
  p <- ggplot() + base_layers() +
    stat_density_2d(data = accidents_xy, aes(X, Y, fill = after_stat(level), alpha = after_stat(level)),
                    geom = "polygon", h = c(500, 500)) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "yellow", high = "red", guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0, 1), guide = "none") +
    geom_point(data = pts, aes(x, y), size = 0.1, colour = "black")
  finish_map(p, paste("Scenario", scenario)) + theme_panel("none")
}
p <- four_panels(lapply(shown, map_hotspots))
save_figure(p, "figure_5_predicted_accident_locations", width = 12, height = 12.4, dpi = 220)
```

# Figure 6: Predicted probabilities

Mean predicted probability per 25 m cell.

```{r figure-6, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 11.1}
map_probability <- function(scenario) {
  p <- ggplot() + base_layers() +
    geom_tile(data = cells(P[[scenario]]), aes(x, y, fill = value), colour = NA) +
    scale_fill_scico("Probability", palette = "lajolla", limits = c(0, 1), direction = -1)
  finish_map(p, paste("Scenario", scenario)) + theme_panel("right")
}
p <- four_panels(lapply(shown, map_probability))
save_figure(p, "figure_6_predicted_probabilities", width = 12, height = 11.1, dpi = 220)
```

# Figure 7: Differences between scenarios

Difference of the mean predicted probability per 25 m cell (second minus first
scenario; negative values = lower predicted probability).

```{r figure-7, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 11}
pairs <- list(c("Realistic", "Baseline", "Baseline to Scenario Realistic"),
              c("Optimal", "Realistic", "Scenario Realistic to Scenario Optimal"),
              c("Optimal", "Baseline", "Baseline to Scenario Optimal"),
              c("Congested", "Optimal", "Scenario Optimal to Scenario Congested"))
map_difference <- function(pp) {
  p <- ggplot() + base_layers() +
    geom_tile(data = cells(P[[pp[1]]] - P[[pp[2]]]), aes(x, y, fill = value), colour = NA) +
    scale_fill_scico("Difference", palette = "vik", limits = c(-1, 1))
  finish_map(p, pp[3]) + theme_panel("right")
}
p <- four_panels(lapply(pairs, map_difference))
save_figure(p, "figure_7_probability_differences", width = 12, height = 11, dpi = 220)
```

# Figure 8: SHAP values

SHAP values of the 14 predictors of the GB model for 600 randomly selected
observations; the colour indicates the feature value (low to high).

```{r figure-8, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6}
shap <- readRDS(file.path(fig_data, "shap_values.rds"))
p <- sv_importance(shapviz(shap$shap, X = shap$X), kind = "beeswarm", max_display = 14) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "#9DB9D3", high = "#B4584A", breaks = c(0, 1), labels = c("Low", "High"),
                        name = "Feature value") +
  labs(x = "SHAP value (contribution to the predicted probability)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
save_figure(p, "figure_8_shap_values", width = 8, height = 6)
```

# Figure 9: Partial dependence

Two-dimensional partial dependence of the predicted accident probability for the
two interaction terms of the model: (a) traffic exposure and speed limit,
(b) road width and speed limit.

```{r figure-9, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4.5}
pd1 <- read.csv(file.path(tab_dir, "partial_dependence_speed_exposure.csv"))
pd2 <- read.csv(file.path(tab_dir, "partial_dependence_roadwidth_speed.csv"))
speed_colours <- c("20" = "#A6C8E0", "30" = "#6FA3C8", "50" = "#3B77A8", "60" = "#1F4E79")   # light = low speed
pd_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
fa <- ggplot(pd1, aes(Exposition, yhat, colour = factor(SpedLmt))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + scale_colour_manual(values = speed_colours) +
  labs(x = "Exposure [vehicles/day]", y = "Partial dependence (probability)", colour = "Speed limit [km/h]",
       title = "(a) Exposure × speed limit") + pd_theme
fb <- ggplot(pd2, aes(RodWdth, yhat, colour = factor(SpedLmt))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + scale_colour_manual(values = speed_colours) +
  labs(x = "Road width [m]", y = "Partial dependence (probability)", colour = "Speed limit [km/h]",
       title = "(b) Road width × speed limit") + pd_theme
p <- (fa | fb) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
save_figure(p, "figure_9_partial_dependence", width = 10, height = 4.5)
```

# Figure S1: Calibration curves

Mean predicted probability vs. observed share of accident points per decile
(spatial block cross-validation, 1,000 m blocks).

```{r figure-S1, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 5}
cal <- read.csv(file.path(tab_dir, "calibration_curves.csv"))
model_colours <- c("RF" = "#9DB9D3", "GB" = "#B4584A", "XGB" = "#3B77A8")
p <- ggplot(cal, aes(x = mean_predicted,
                     y = observed_share,
                     colour = model)) +
  geom_abline(lty = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colours) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean predicted probability (decile)",
    y = "Observed share of accident points",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
save_figure(p, "figure_S1_calibration", width = 5, height = 5)
```
